page.layout: One page of text, one column of short question lines, set ragged and indented in places. The running head is at the top, the page number at the top left, and a catchword at the lower right. No margin notes.

l.i: Circa Genevæ plagiarium quid velit Deus
Quid circa profectionem Patris generalis in
Quid circa breve & oleum Patris generalis.
Qua ratione converti rex Anglia, regina &
Turca qua supplantari ratione, qua converti
Quo pacto reparare possim omnes defectus
Quid maxime illum urgeat in exorm̃.
Quid circa Genevæ conservationem tam sæpe.

page.notes: The Q-initials of each question are large ornamental swash capitals, and the first letter of each question is set as a swash Q. The abbreviation "exorm̃" has a superscript mark over the m, transcribed with a tilde. The italic "Hisp." and "Æquare solo." lines are short continuation or answer lines. No printing errors were marked. The catchword "Quo" at the lower right is the start of the next page's first question.
